description: Phase 2 transaction UIs wired to live /api/v1 lists + draft create: Opening Stock, Requisitions, GRN, Gatepass inward/outward, Issues, Transfers, Returns. Dropdowns from masters APIs. Saves require at least one line (item+qty) as SAVE_DRAFT.
notes: Opening Stock form maps all API/DB line fields (qty, rate, mrp, batchLotNo, mfgDate, expiryDate, locationBin). Edit loads GET /opening-stock/{docId}. Entry No is auto OST-yyyy-####. List includes entityId. Store Requisition has since moved out of TransactionPages.tsx into its own full-featured page — see features/store-requisition.json.
